paragraphs: Quantcast’s real‑time ad optimisation demands models that can adapt instantly; I built a tool‑calling LLM agent that resolves gene aliases, explains scoring methodology and tracks dataset provenance for a multi‑omics cancer platform, proving my ability to create responsive, domain‑specific AI solutions.

I constructed scikit‑learn pipelines and LSTM, BiRNN and CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, then deployed them as FastAPI services in Docker, demonstrating my skill in turning complex models into production‑ready services.
